conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL computes a command-valid decision from control fields and exports it: valid_cmd <= '1' when (ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu='1') and (ctrl_i.ir_opcode(5)='1') and (ctrl_i.ir_funct3(2)='1') and (ctrl_i.ir_funct3(0)='1') and (ctrl_i.ir_funct12(11 downto 5) = "0000111") else '0'; valid_o <= valid_cmd. The cond_out process tests valid_cmd to gate res_o. Corruption of this decision would incorrectly enable/disable the conditional copy or the exported valid_o, establishing Integrity.

The RTL computes a condition from rs2 and a control bit: rs2_zero <= '1' when (rs2_i = zero_c) else '0'; condition <= rs2_zero xnor ctrl_i.ir_funct3(1). The cond_out process requires condition = '1' together with valid_cmd to forward rs1 to res_o. Altering this decision changes when the copy occurs, establishing Integrity.

conceptual assets.concept: Result output value (res_o) — conditional copy of rs1 or zero
conceptual assets.reasoning: The cond_out process drives the exported result on clock edges: on reset res_o <= (others => '0'); elsif rising_edge(clk_i) then if (valid_cmd='1') and (condition='1') then res_o <= rs1_i; else res_o <= (others => '0'); end if. The correctness of res_o depends on rs1_i and the computed valid_cmd and condition; corruption of those inputs or decisions changes the reported result, establishing Integrity.
